title: Pokemon TCG Korean Jynx Pokemon 151 124/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Jynx Pokémon card is a must-have addition to any serious collector's set. With its stunning water-colored artwork and ultra-rare holo finish, this card is sure to impress. As a Stage 2 Pokémon, Jynx has a formidable 160 HP and is a valuable addition to any deck.

This card is from the Pokemon 151 set and has the card number 124/165. It is a Korean language card manufactured by Nintendo. The card is a Psychic type and is specialized as an EX card. It is not autographed and is perfect for anyone looking to complete their collection.
